DraftOutput.subject: Acme's Europe expansion
DraftOutput.body:
Hi Priya,

Saw that Acme Analytics raised $40M to expand into Europe. New markets usually mean more payment processors and more reconciliation work at month-end. LedgerLens automates revenue reconciliation across payment processors, so the finance team spends less time matching transactions by hand as volumes grow. If Europe is adding processors to your stack this year, it could be useful to compare notes on how other finance teams are handling it. Would a short conversation be useful?

Best,
[Your name]
